chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abdullah narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from al-'Ala' from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said to me: 'Perform the night prayer, the Witr prayer, and the two rak'ahs while riding (in the saddle/camel-back).'
ai.seo_question: What voluntary prayers should be performed while traveling according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) establishes the permissibility and recommendation of performing voluntary prayers, including the night prayer (Tahajjud) and Witr, while riding during travel. It highlights the flexibility in Shia jurisprudence regarding prayer postures, allowing the rider to pray in a seated position on their mount without needing to dismount, thereby facilitating continuous devotion amidst the hardships of journeying.
